description: Stabilizes risky inherited Python code through source identity, behavior discovery, safe characterization, seams, rollback, and explicit residual risk. Project-agnostic; host-specific governance is optional.
user_intent_examples: Stabilize this risky inherited module before changing behavior.
when_to_load: When existing Python code is risky, poorly understood, weakly protected, side-effectful, or historically brittle.
when_not_to_load: Do not load for a well-understood greenfield module or as a substitute for the refactoring or testing owners.
do_not_regress: Do not define all legacy code solely as code without tests.
Do not use raw production data or uncontrolled side effects for characterization.
Do not require sys.path mutation or importlib.reload as default seams.
Do not categorically refuse every bounded emergency change.
Do not force companion prompts or startup loading.
